battle.name: 一二八事變
battle.brief: 1931年1月28日夜至3月3日，日本陸軍同海軍陸戰隊突襲上海閘北，第十九路軍沿吳淞至廟行一線死守三十五日。卡面法國雷管步槍以銅殼底火抵禦江浙冬霧，射程亦勝火繩同火槍，正是十九路軍手中漢陽八八年式步槍的祖型來源。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 一二八事變是中華民國同大日本帝國在1931年1月28日至3月3日於上海進行的一場都市攻防戰。中國方面真正頂住前線的是第十九路軍，總指揮蔡廷鍇、參謀長蔣鼎文，序列上有第六十一師（師長沈濤）、第七十八師（師長區壽年）、補充旅，另有炮兵營、工兵營同上海市保安團、稅警總團、義警隊負責華界閘北一帶的治安與徵召；上海市政府由市長吳鐵城主持，國民政府軍事委員會委員長蔣中正則在南京遙控全局。租界方面，公共租界工部局同上海義勇軍維持市面秩序，各國領事館與外商集中在租界中部同南部，靠外國水兵同巡捕房守住界內。日本方面，關東軍參謀長石原莞爾是背後策動者；上海一線由第十一師團（師團長白川乙三，2月初抵滬接掌前線統一指揮）、第六混成旅團、第22旅團擔任陸戰主力，另有上海特務海軍陸戰隊同海軍第三艦隊的艦隊在長江口同黃浦江上游提供艦砲支援。華界同租界北部一帶因此成為兩個國家軍隊在同一座城市面對面交火的戰場，雙方都未將戰火推入租界腹地。
countriesEn: The January 28 Incident was an urban battle fought in Shanghai from 28 January to 3 March 1931 between the Republic of China and the Empire of Japan. On the Chinese side the front was actually held by the 19th Route Army, under commander-in-chief Cai Tingkai and chief of staff Chiang Ting-wen, whose order of battle included the 61st Division under Shen Tao, the 78th Division under Ou Shou-nien, a reserve brigade, and artillery and engineer units, together with the Shanghai municipal security corps, the tax police and the volunteer constabulary responsible for order and mobilisation in the Chinese district of Zhabei; the Shanghai municipal government was headed by mayor Wu Tieh-cheng, while Chiang Kai-shek, chairman of the Nationalist Military Council, directed events from Nanjing. Inside the concessions, the International Settlement municipal council and the Shanghai Volunteer Corps kept the streets running, with the foreign consulates and commercial community concentrated in the central and southern concessions, guarded by foreign marines and the police. On the Japanese side the Kwantung Army staff chief Kanji Ishiwara was the behind-the-scenes promoter, while the land effort in Shanghai was carried by the 11th Division under Kitsuji Shirakawa, who arrived in early February to take overall command of the front, together with the 6th Mixed Brigade and the 22nd Brigade; the Shanghai Special Naval Landing Force and the ships of the Japanese Third Fleet in the Yangtze mouth and on the upper Huangpu provided naval gunfire support. The Chinese district of Zhabei and the northern fringes of the International Settlement thus became a battlefield in which the field armies of two states fought face to face inside a single city, and neither side pushed the fighting into the heart of the concessions.
people: 中方的關鍵人物是第十九路軍總指揮蔡廷鍇同參謀長蔣鼎文。蔡廷鍇早年入雲南講武堂讀書，抗日戰爭時期亦曾獨當一面；他在閘北至吳淞之間劃定一條約二十公里長的防線，命令各師分段據守，屢次頂住日軍夜襲，事後成為全國民眾眼中的抗戰名將。蔣鼎文負責與日方接觸，最終在3月3日談成停戰，被視為保存實力的關鍵人物。第六十一師師長沈濤同第七十八師師長區壽年分別掌握第一線與第二線陣地，旅、團級指揮員譚啟秀、黃強等率部進行夜襲反擊。上海市長吳鐵城在租界遇刺時受傷，由人攙扶離開。更高層面上，蔣中正利用這場衝突處理寧漢分裂，藉中央軍入粵把廣州方面壓下去。
peopleEn: The decisive Chinese figures were the 19th Route Army commander-in-chief Cai Tingkai and his chief of staff Chiang Ting-wen. Cai had trained at the Yunnan Military Academy and would later command in his own right during the Sino-Japanese War; in Shanghai he laid out a front roughly twenty kilometres long between Zhabei and Wusong, ordered each division to hold its own sector, and repeatedly turned back Japanese night attacks, which made him a national hero in the public imagination. Chiang Ting-wen handled contact with the Japanese and finally concluded the truce on 3 March, and is generally credited with preserving the army's fighting strength. Division commanders Shen Tao of the 61st and Ou Shou-nien of the 78th respectively held the first and second lines, while brigade and regimental officers such as Tan Qixiu and Huang Qiang led counter-attacks at night. Shanghai mayor Wu Tieh-cheng was wounded in the assassination in the concession and had to be helped away. At a higher level Chiang Kai-shek used the crisis to settle the Nanking-Wang split, moving central government troops into Guangdong and crushing the Cantonese rival administration.
kits: 卡面那件兵器是法國雷管步槍。1840年前後，法軍制式步槍用銅殼底火（雷管）取代火繩與火燧，不必再靠火種傳火，扣動槍機即可擊發，濕霧天氣照樣打得響，擊錘也由外露形式改成直接撞擊底火；這個原理沿著法國1886年米涅式步槍傳到德國1888年製式步槍，再傳到湖北槍炮廠1891年仿製的漢陽八八年式步槍——十九路軍士兵在閘北手中正是這一支部槍，它是全軍的制式步槍，卡面這件法國雷管步槍就是該譜系的起點。同一場戰鬥中，中軍步兵以漢陽八八式步槍配刺刀為主，輔以手榴彈與少量輕機槍、迫擊砲；十九路軍最出名的是「麻將牌大刀」，刀面鑄有「九一八」與「十八軍」字樣，夜戰時用來近身劈砍。砲兵方面有清末江南製造總局留下的吳淞砲台舊式大炮，但多已失修或炮身被拆走，實際火力有限。日軍方面，步兵以南部式三八式步槍（6.5毫米）為主，配十一年式輕機關槍、九六式機關槍同擲彈筒，海軍陸戰隊另備輕機關槍與迫擊砲，近程火力密度高於中方。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a French percussion rifle. Around 1840 French service muskets replaced the match and the burning cord with a copper-capped primer, so that the gun no longer needed a lit match to fire: squeezing the trigger struck the primer directly, and the weapon still went off in wet, foggy weather. The same principle travelled from the French Lebel rifle of 1886 to the German service rifle of 1888, and from there to the Hanyang Model 88 rifle copied at the Hanyang Arsenal in Hubei in 1891. That is exactly the weapon in the hands of 19th Route Army soldiers in Zhabei, the army's standard infantry arm, so the French percussion rifle on the card is the ancestor of that line. In the same battle the Chinese infantry fought with Hanyang Model 88 rifles and bayonets, supported by hand grenades and a small number of light machine guns and mortars. The 19th Route Army was famous for its big sabres, the so-called mahjong-tile dadao, the blade cast with the characters 'September 18' and the mark of the 18th Army, used for close-quarter chopping during night fighting. On the artillery side, the old coastal guns left behind by the Jiangnan Arsenal at the Wusong fort were mostly out of repair or had their barrels removed, so their real firepower was limited. The Japanese infantry relied on the 6.5mm Arisaka Type 38 rifle, with Type 11 and Type 96 light and heavy machine guns and grenade dischargers, while the naval landing force carried light machine guns and mortars of its own, giving them a higher density of close-range fire than the Chinese.
tactics: 十九路軍打的是典型縱深野戰守備：主陣地由西向東拉成吳淞砲台—吳淞鎮—江灣—廟行—龍華一線，前沿推到閘北與租界北部接壤的寶山路、西藏路一帶，縱深約數公里，以交通壕、機槍巢與加固樓房構成。廟行被定為總預備隊陣地，吳淞砲台是前哨，閘北市區就是巷戰地帶；十九路軍熟悉租界與華界之間的弄堂、鐵路、碼頭與工廠位置，善用夜間發動突擊與短兵相接的大刀戰，迫擊砲集中火力打擊日軍集結地與炮位，並以工廠、學校等鋼筋水泥建築作為支撐點。日軍則靠兵種齊整的優勢，由海軍陸戰隊先行奪取租界北部據點，步兵依托機關槍與迫擊砲逐點推進，晝夜輪番進攻，並由吳淞外海的艦隊提供大口徑艦砲射擊，試圖切斷閘北與吳淞之間的聯繫。全程戰火大致沿著租界北部邊界展開，中方主力始終沒有深入租界腹地，租界中部與南部的外商及領事館靠上海義勇軍與外國水兵維持秩序。
tacticsEn: The 19th Route Army fought a typical deep defensive battle. Its main line ran from west to east along Wusong fort, Wusong town, Jiangwan, Miaoxing and Longhua, with the forward edge pushed up to Baoshan Road and Xizang Road where the Chinese district of Zhabei met the northern concession, and a depth of several kilometres built up from communication trenches, machine-gun nests and reinforced buildings. Miaoxing was designated as the position of the general reserve, Wusong fort served as the outpost, and the streets of Zhabei became the ground for close-quarter fighting. The 19th Route Army knew the lanes, railways, wharves and factory compounds that lay between the concession and the Chinese district, and made much use of night attacks and sabre combat, with mortars concentrated on Japanese assembly areas and gun positions; factories, schools and other concrete structures were turned into strongpoints. Japan, with a more balanced order of battle, used the naval landing force to seize northern concession positions first, then advanced point by point with machine guns and mortars, attacking day and night in turn, while the fleet in the waters off Wusong delivered heavy naval gunfire in an attempt to sever the link between Zhabei and Wusong. The fighting stayed close to the northern boundary of the concession throughout; the Chinese main force never pushed deep into the concession, and the foreign business community and consulates in the central and southern districts relied on the Shanghai Volunteer Corps and foreign marines to keep order.
data: 這場衝突由1月28日夜間開打，到3月3日雙方達成停戰，前後約三十五日。中方交戰部隊以第十九路軍三個師為主，兵員約一萬九千至三萬人；日軍投入第十一師團第六混成旅團與第22旅團、上海特務海軍陸戰隊，合計一萬人上下。戰線自吳淞至廟行約二十公里，每公里正面大約一個營的量級。傷亡方面，中方各類記載多指十九路軍官兵陣亡、重傷約五千人上下，日方傷亡約二千至三千人，其中相當一部分是海軍陸戰隊與步兵；另有一艘日方驅逐艦在吳淞外海被中方炮火擊中受損。時間線上，蔣汪會談原定1月28日在上海重開，事變就在同一晚爆發。停戰協議5月5日在上海簽訂，條款大致包括中國軍隊撤出上海市區、市區內不得駐紮中國軍隊、上海市行政權歸還中國，以及租界內不得有中國方面武裝人員。
dataEn: The fighting began on the night of 28 January and the two sides reached a truce on 3 March, a matter of about thirty-five days. The Chinese forces engaged were the three divisions of the 19th Route Army, with a strength somewhere between nineteen thousand and thirty thousand men. Japan committed the 6th Mixed Brigade and 22nd Brigade of the 11th Division together with the Shanghai Special Naval Landing Force, roughly ten thousand men in all. The front stretched about twenty kilometres from Wusong to Miaoxing, an average of about one battalion per kilometre of frontage. On losses, most Chinese accounts put dead and wounded among the 19th Route Army at around five thousand, while Japanese casualties are generally given as two to three thousand, a substantial share of them in the naval landing force and infantry; one Japanese destroyer was also hit and damaged by Chinese shellfire in the waters off Wusong. On the timeline, the Chiang-Wang talks were due to resume in Shanghai on 28 January, and the incident broke out on the very same night. The armistice agreement was signed in Shanghai on 5 May, its terms broadly providing for the withdrawal of Chinese troops from the city, a ban on Chinese troops remaining in Shanghai, the return of Shanghai's administrative authority to China, and a ban on Chinese armed personnel inside the concessions.
cause: 直接導火線是1931年1月政治與軍事兩條線同時埋下。第一，寧漢分裂：蔣中正在南京召開第二次國民會議，汪精衛、陳公博一方的廣州方面1月28日在廣州宣布成立「保護中華民國國民政府」，上海正是兩派爭執的中心，蔣汪會談定於1月28日在上海重開；1月14日，國民黨上海市黨部委員兼宣傳部長袁世偉在租界被暗殺，兇手指向黨內反對會商的一方，會商隨即破裂。第二，九一八事變之後，關東軍佔領東北，國際聯盟只是查問，美國史汀生主義亦未落到武器禁運，蔣中正判斷關東軍有餘力再向南方施壓。第三，日本駐上海陸軍與海軍陸戰隊不斷擴編，1月27日第十九路軍奉命由蘇州向上海移動、駐紮閘北，日方視為威脅，遂要求中國軍隊「退出上海」。1月28日夜，日軍以租界北部寶山路一帶與中國便衣警察、義警交火為由發動攻擊，上海市長吳鐵城同日本駐上海總領事森下小三郎在租界遇刺，森下當場死亡，日方即以此宣布開戰。
causeEn: The immediate trigger lay in two lines of political and military pressure that came together in January 1931. First, the Nanking-Wang split: Chiang Kai-shek convened the second National Conference in Nanking, and the Cantonese faction of Wang Jingwei and Chen Gongbo proclaimed a 'Protective Government of the Republic of China' in Guangzhou on 28 January. Shanghai was the very centre of that quarrel, and the Chiang-Wang talks were scheduled to resume there on 28 January. On 14 January Yuan Shiwei, a member and propaganda chief of the Shanghai branch of the Nationalist Party, was assassinated in the concession, the assassin pointing to one of the factions opposed to the talks, and the conference collapsed. Second, after the Mukden Incident the Kwantung Army held Manchuria, the League of Nations only opened an enquiry, and the American Stimson Doctrine never translated into an arms embargo, so Chiang Kai-shek judged that the Kwantung Army had the strength to press further south. Third, the Japanese army in Shanghai and the naval landing force were steadily expanded, and on 27 January the 19th Route Army was ordered forward from Suzhou to take up positions at Zhabei; the Japanese read this as a threat and demanded that Chinese troops 'withdraw from Shanghai'. On the night of 28 January the Japanese opened fire, citing a clash with Chinese plainclothes police and volunteer constables around Baoshan Road in the northern concession, and the assassination in the concession of Shanghai mayor Wu Tieh-cheng and of the Japanese consul-general in Shanghai, Morishita Saburo, who died on the spot, was used as the pretext for war.
impact: 一二八事變有三層後果。第一，外交上：停戰協定雖然是以中方讓步換來，但換到了「上海市行政權歸還中國」，上海租界的中國居民第一次在法理上不再是外人，成為全國輿論最大的收穫，上海市長吳鐵城也因此名重一時。第二，黨政上：蔣中正藉著上海方面受壓的局面，用中央軍入粵，廣州國民政府4月崩解，寧漢分裂結束，國民政府可以全力「剿共」，第一次國共合作至此徹底破裂；十九路軍之後被拆散調離，據說建制也未完整保留，蔡廷鍇等一批將領淡出軍政核心。第三，亞洲與國際局面上：聯盟的軟弱回應令關東軍可以放手經營滿洲，1932年1月28日同一天，日軍再以更大規模攻擊上海，演成「一·二八事變」；十四年抗戰的序幕，也由這幾日拉開。
impactEn: The January 28 Incident had three layers of consequence. First, diplomatically: although the truce was bought with Chinese concessions, China obtained the clause returning the administration of Shanghai to Chinese hands, and for the first time the Chinese residents of the concessions were not foreigners in law; this was the greatest gain for national opinion, and it made mayor Wu Tieh-cheng a household name. Second, in party and state politics: Chiang Kai-shek used the pressure on the Shanghai front to move central government troops into Guangdong, the Canton government collapsed in April, the Nanking-Wang split ended, and the Nationalist government was free to concentrate on suppressing the Communists, so that the first United Front between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party was broken for good. The 19th Route Army was afterwards disbanded and dispersed, and the formation was not even kept intact; officers such as Cai Tingkai faded out of the political and military centre. Third, in the Asian and international situation: the weakness of the League of Nations' response allowed the Kwantung Army to consolidate Manchuria, and on 28 January 1932, exactly a year later, Japan attacked Shanghai on a far greater scale, producing the January 28, 1932 Incident; the opening phase of China's fourteen-year war of resistance also dates from these few days.
result: 作戰結果：十九路軍靠夜襲與大刀近戰在閘北、廟行、吳淞一線頂住日軍三十五日，沒有讓日軍推入租界腹地，日軍也始終沒有拿下廟行與吳淞砲台全線，雙方僵持之下日方提出停戰。1月29日十九路軍一度收復吳淞砲台，2月初再以夜戰反擊，但日軍以艦砲猛攻吳淞，砲台守軍傷亡慘重，火力失效。3月3日停戰生效，戰線回復到吳淞—江灣一線，中國軍隊退出租界區域。5月5日《中日上海停戰協定》在上海簽訂，中方承諾撤軍、上海市行政權歸還中國、租界內不得有中國武裝人員；日方則取得在上海及周邊長期駐兵的權利，也為關東軍在東北的擴張爭取到喘息空間。戰役以雙方「不打不成」的妥協收場，中方得地未得勢，日方則把上海變成下一輪進攻的前進基地。
resultEn: The military result was that the 19th Route Army, fighting with night attacks and sabre combat, held the line at Zhabei, Miaoxing and Wusong against the Japanese for thirty-five days. The Japanese were never able to push into the heart of the concession, and they never took the whole of the Miaoxing and Wusong fort line either, and when the impasse held the Japanese proposed a truce. On 29 January the 19th Route Army retook Wusong fort, and at the beginning of February it counter-attacked again at night, but the Japanese brought naval gunfire to bear on Wusong, where the garrison suffered heavily and the fort's firepower was rendered useless. The truce took effect on 3 March and the front returned to the Wusong-Jiangwan line, with Chinese troops withdrawing out of the concession area. On 5 May the Sino-Japanese Shanghai Armistice Agreement was signed in Shanghai: China undertook to withdraw its troops, to return Shanghai's administration to Chinese hands and to keep Chinese armed personnel out of the concessions, while Japan secured the right to maintain a long-term military presence in and around Shanghai, and the Kwantung Army in Manchuria gained room to breathe. The campaign ended in a compromise in which neither side could win, China gained ground without gaining advantage, and Japan turned Shanghai into the forward base for its next offensive.
